title: Sentry Guard MONSTER
tagline: Autonomous pan-tilt turret! Scans the perimeter with ultrasonic radar and targets invaders with a red laser!

phases.instructions: Collect 2x SG90 servo motors, HC-SR04 ultrasonic sensor, KY-008 Laser diode module, piezo buzzer, and cardboard turret brackets.
verificationCheckpoints: 2x SG90 servo motors with dual horns ready

phases.instructions: Wire Pan Servo to Pin 9, Tilt Servo to Pin 10, Laser to Pin 6, Buzzer to Pin 7, and Ultrasonic TRIG/ECHO to pins 11/12.
verificationCheckpoints: Servos connected to PWM pins 9 and 10
Laser (+) connected to Pin 6 with ground to Dark Slate rail

phases.instructions: CRITICAL LASER SAFETY: Never point the laser into anyone's eyes or look directly into the beam aperture. Test only against a non-reflective wall or paper target.
verificationCheckpoints: Turret pointed toward empty wall target area

phases.instructions: Review how the pan servo sweeps 30 to 150 degrees while sonar calculates obstacle coordinates and activates target tracking lock.
phases.codeExplanation:
- The pan servo sweeps continuously in 5-degree increments across 120 degrees of field of view.
- At each angle, pingDistance() samples obstacle range.
- If an obstacle appears within 25cm, turret halts, illuminates laser target dot, and sounds audio lock chirp.
verificationCheckpoints: Understand target lock condition and actuator sequence

phases.instructions: Upload sketch, place target box 20cm away within sweep sector, and observe autonomous radar tracking lock-on!
verificationCheckpoints: Turret sweeps back and forth smoothly
Targets trigger laser pulse and alert tone

phases.instructions: Turret defense active! You mastered pan-tilt robotic kinematics and sensor-guided target acquisition.
verificationCheckpoints: Ready to claim Turret Commander badge

story: Build an Autonomous Sentry Turret! Construct a dual-axis pan/tilt motorized gimbal armed with an ultrasonic sonar radar and a visible red targeting laser that automatically sweeps the perimeter and locks onto approaching targets.

troubleshooting.symptom: Servos violently jitter during radar sweep
troubleshooting.cause: Both servos drawing peak current simultaneously from Arduino 5V rail
troubleshooting.solution: Add a separate 5V power supply for the servos with shared ground, or add a large 470uF decoupling capacitor across power rails.
diagnosticSteps: Two servos exceed 500mA USB limit simultaneously.
Power servo rail with external 5V/6V supply and bridge GNDs.
